name: TST workspace tools and independent permission execution

authorities.tst: structural workspace discovery and memory/evidence substrate
authorities.permission_broker: whether a model-requested protected operation may execute
authorities.sqlite_tool_executions: durable tool-call audit; separate from visible chat transcript
authorities.pe3: task-local observed-path and workspace-staleness projection only
authorities.renderer: permission UI projection only; never executes tools directly

permission_policy.ordinary_workspace_read: allow unless graph-first gate is explicitly enabled
permission_policy.edit_write: ask unless guarded session auto proves the exact resource is safe
permission_policy.bash: ask except narrow metadata-only safe-bash classifier
permission_policy.always: session-scoped exact action/resource fingerprint only; never wildcard
permission_policy.guarded_auto: session-scoped; workspace-contained non-sensitive read/edit/write resources only
permission_policy.plan_mode: read-only; mutation and arbitrary shell denied
permission_policy.noninteractive: operations requiring a prompt fail closed

safe_bash_family: git status with bounded status flags
git log requiring --oneline with bounded flags
git branch with bounded read-only flags
git rev-parse for repository metadata only
security_invariants: filesystem paths may not escape the project root
symlink escapes are not guarded-auto eligible
secret-like and credential files are not guarded-auto eligible
OpenCode is not a production dependency
renderer and preload expose approval decisions, not filesystem or shell primitives
tool output is untrusted model input and is not durable visible transcript content
a tool may not be reported successful unless its runtime execution succeeded
Stop/cancellation aborts permission waits and active execution
acceptance: streamed OpenAI-compatible tool calls reconstruct correctly
tool execution audit stays separate from visible transcript
duplicate structural exploration is suppressed per session
full runtime can block on permission, resume, mutate, audit, and complete
all inherited migration gates remain green
